eval: (async () => { await import('/sandbox/party_follow.js'); PF.suite = 'party.follow.combat'; const r = await PF.ready(); const none = PF.nobody(); await PF.sleep(1500); window.__pf = { p0: PF.programs(), scene0: PF.scene(), batched: !!__game.game.blobs }; PF.expect(!!__game.game.combat && window.__pf.batched, 'Cinderwatch Pass: a combat level, the actors\' contact shadows in one batch'); return JSON.stringify({ ...r, none, p0: window.__pf.p0, scene: window.__pf.scene0 }); })()

(async () => { const g = __game.game; const a = await __game.party.join('maren'); const b = await __game.party.join('ilse'); const c = await __game.party.join('pip'); PF.fakeUI(); const s = __game.state(); PF.expect(!!a && !!b && !!c && s.party.members.map((m) => m.cls).join() === 'warden,mystic,ranger', 'three villagers join, each as the class its weapon makes (sword: warden, staff: mystic, bow: ranger): ' + JSON.stringify(s.party.members.map((m) => [m.id, m.cls]))); await PF.frame(); await PF.frame(); const far = PF.member('pip'); PF.expect(g.party.stats.snaps >= 1 && Math.hypot(far.position.x - g.player.position.x, far.position.z - g.player.position.z) < 17, 'Pip, 38 u away when she joined, is put behind the player at once (the snap)'); const m = PF.member('maren'); PF.expect(g.blobs.sprites.includes(m.sprite) && Object.hasOwn(m.sprite.shadowProxy, 'intersectsFrustum'), 'on a combat level a member\'s blob is drawn by the level\'s batch and its sun quad only in the shadow pass'); PF.expect(m.sprite._fx === true && m.sprite.material.type === g.player.sprite.material.type, 'a member\'s sprite is the player\'s material kind (lit, combatFx)'); PF.checkHidden('combat level'); return JSON.stringify({ members: PF.brief(), legend: document.querySelector('.lu-help')?.textContent ?? null }); })()

(async () => { const p = PF.programs(); PF.expect(p === __pf.p0, 'no program compiled by three joins on a combat level: ' + p + ' / ' + __pf.p0); const leg = document.querySelector('.lu-help')?.textContent ?? ''; PF.expect(/Party/.test(leg), 'the combat legend gains G — Party: ' + leg.slice(0, 200)); return JSON.stringify({ programs: [__pf.p0, p], members: PF.brief() }); })()

(async () => { const g = __game.game; const P = g.player.position; const pts = [[P.x, P.z - 5], [P.x + 3, P.z - 8]]; const bad = PF.checkRoute([P.x, P.z], pts); const r = await PF.drive(pts, { label: 'a few steps on a combat level' }); PF.checkDrive(r); return JSON.stringify({ bad, drive: r }); })()

(async () => { const g = __game.game; const m = PF.member('maren'); const sprite = m.sprite; __game.party.leave('maren'); __game.party.leave('ilse'); __game.party.leave('pip'); await PF.sleep(300); PF.expect(!g.blobs.sprites.includes(sprite), 'a member who left is out of the blob batch'); const sc = PF.scene(); PF.expect(sc.members === 0, 'no member sprite left in the scene'); PF.expect(PF.programs() === __pf.p0, 'no program compiled by anything the party did: ' + PF.programs()); return JSON.stringify({ scene: sc, scene0: __pf.scene0, programs: PF.programs(), failed: PF.failed }); })()

(async () => { const g = __game.game; const c = __game.combat; c.reset(); __game.teleport(51.5, 77.5); await PF.sleep(300); const j = await __game.party.join('pip', { cls: 'ranger' }); PF.expect(!!j, 'Pip joins again (a ranger)'); const pl = g.player; pl.facing.set(0, 0, 1); pl.sprite.faceVector(0, 1); __game.teleport(53.5, 85); const m = PF.member('pip'); const mode0 = m.follow.mode; await PF.frame(); c.god(true); const pack = __game.combat.enemies().filter((e) => e.uid.startsWith('glade_goblins#')).map((e) => e.uid); for (const u of pack) c.wake(u); const held = await PF.until(() => m.follow.held === 'combat', 6000); const mode1 = m.follow.mode; const P = pl.position; m.placeAt(P.x - 5, P.z - 1); c.freezeAI(true); pl.moveOverride = { x: 0, z: 1 }; await PF.sleep(120); pl.moveOverride = null; await PF.sleep(300); c.freezeAI(false); for (const u of pack) c.kill(u); const free = await PF.until(() => !m.follow.held, 8000); await PF.sleep(4000); const d = Math.hypot(m.position.x - P.x, m.position.z - P.z); const rest = __game.party.trail('pip', 0).members[0].rest; const dr = Math.hypot(rest.x - P.x, rest.z - P.z); c.god(false); PF.expect(mode0 === 'placed' && held && mode1 === 'trail', 'a member put behind the player whom a fight takes over follows the trail from then on (not placed): ' + JSON.stringify([mode0, held, mode1])); PF.expect(free && d < 4 && dr < 4 && m.follow.mode === 'trail', 'after the fight it comes back to the player and rests near it (its rest spot worked out again, not where it stood): ' + JSON.stringify({ free, d: +d.toFixed(2), rest, dr: +dr.toFixed(2), mode: m.follow.mode })); __game.party.leave('pip'); await PF.sleep(300); return JSON.stringify({ mode0, mode1, d: +d.toFixed(2), dr: +dr.toFixed(2), failed: PF.failed }); })()
